stem: Mini buys 6 bananas at Rs 7 each and writes $6 \times 7$ for the cost she should pay.

options.text: $6 \times 7$ is an arithmetic expression for the cost, and its value is 42.
42 is the expression; $6 \times 7$ is only a name for that value.
The expression must be the printed 7 alone, because 7 is the last number she sees.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice that uses expression and value.

part_answers.answer: An arithmetic expression is the phrase built from numbers and operations; here $6 \times 7$ is that phrase and it evaluates to 42.

teacher.key_rationale: 6×7 is the arithmetic expression for the cost and its value is 42. Calling 42 the expression swaps value for expression. Picking the printed 7 alone is a surface cue.
